author: rozaru
body:
FlyBase annotation done.
Will GO:0006735 NADH regeneration be obsolete at some point? (see ticket https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29818)

author: pgaudet
body:
@rozaru 

> Will GO:0006735 NADH regeneration be obsolete at some point?

(see ticket https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29818)

It seems like you had objections. Should we keep it and close the ticket?

author: rozaru
body:
@pgaudet I misunderstood, I thought you wanted to keep it and I was trying to make a case that there are better terms (ex: shuttles).
I think it’s best to obsolete it.

For the 2 genes that have a manual annotation: 
  MDH3 (P32419) IMP
  SPAC26H5.09c (O13991) ISO
probably a specific term such as 'malate-oxaloacetate shuttle’ for the peroxisome could be created based on the mitondria malate-aspartate shuttle.
